Documentation.UserDocu: The values a sheet's features share (docs/SheetMetal.md sec 4.6)

hasGauge() -> bool
Whether the rule's material card has the SheetMetal model and a gauge row for the rule's thickness.

resetRuleValue(name)
Give the value named back to the card: BendRadius, KFactor, MinFlange or AllowanceMethod.

bendAllowance(angle, radius=None) -> float
The flat length in mm of a bend of the rule's thickness through angle (deg), of the rule's radius unless given another (mm), by the rule's allowance method.
